Field_Description: Determines the level gpio pin. Read returns the current value of the corresponding pin regardless of whether the pin is an input or an output
Expected_Result: Read should return current pin value; Write has no effect (RO field)

Field_Description: RAWST bit: Interrupt raw status On Read returns latched raw interrupt status based on interrupt settings
Expected_Result: Read should return latched raw interrupt status; Write has no effect (RO field)

Field_Description: Writing 1 clears the interrupt raw status. Writing 0 No change
Expected_Result: Write 1 to clear interrupt raw status; Read returns 0 (WO field)

Field_Description: Pos-edge interrupt enable; 1-Enable interrupt when rising edge (pos edge) is detected on gpio pin; 0-Disable interrupt on pos-edge detection
Expected_Result: Write value and read back should match written value

Field_Description: Neg-edge interrupt enable; 1-Enable interrupt when falling edge (neg edge) is detected on gpio pin; 0-Disable interrupt on neg-edge detection
Expected_Result: Write value and read back should match written value

Field_Description: GPIO Pin signal level on which interrupt should be generated. 0-generate interrupt on level 0; 1-generate interrupt on level 1
Expected_Result: Write value and read back should match written value

Field_Description: GPIO mode select: selects gpio either in output mode or input mode; 0-Set GPIO in output mode; 1-Set GPIO in input mode
Expected_Result: Write value and read back should match written value (RW2 - hardware may override)
